COLDWAR_NKO_complete_chondo_reclamation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_NKO_can_chondo_reclamation = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_chondo_reclamation_earned }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_chondo_reclamation_earned
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0125 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				603 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO agriculture_district < 10 }
			}
			603 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = agriculture_district level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				1200 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO agriculture_district < 10 }
			}
			1200 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = agriculture_district level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_NKO_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

			limit = {

			}
			1201 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				1200 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO infrastructure < 6 }
			}
			1200 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }

		if = {
			limit = {
				602 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO arms_factory < 35 }
			}
			602 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				601 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO arms_factory < 35 }
			}
			601 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}

	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_NKO_can_harbour_workshops = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_harbour_workshops_earned }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_harbour_workshops_earned
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.014 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NKO_harbour_workshops_programme }
		if = {
			limit = {
				601 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO dockyard < 20 is_coastal = yes }
			}
			601 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				1199 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO dockyard < 20 is_coastal = yes }
			}
			1199 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				602 = { is_owned_by = NKO is_controlled_by = NKO dockyard < 20 is_coastal = yes }
			}
			602 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_NKO_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_NKO_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = NKO IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_NKO_1970_focus }
			}
			load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_NKO_1970_focus
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_initialized
		}
		COLDWAR_NKO_refresh_programmes = yes
		COLDWAR_NKO_foreign_refresh = yes
		COLDWAR_NKO_succession_daily = yes
	}
}
